Studied: Etiquette.description:
🍵 You learned formal manners: honorific speech, tea ceremony, business protocol, or a family that hosted important guests.

🌱 Bows, seating order, gifts, business cards and conduct at galas and agency meetings. You know what offends an official or a sponsor.
⚠️ Unfamiliar foreign customs and the hidden politics of an old hero family can still trip you.
⚖️ Perfect manners grant no rank or invitation, and polite words do not hide bad intent from people who watch closely.
🏫 It shows in correct posture, measured speech and a reflex to stand when a senior enters.

📈 Grants: Etiquette +15
Studied: Etiquette.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied etiquette: honorific and humble speech, bows, seating order, gift customs, the exchange of business cards and conduct at ceremonies, galas and agency meetings. They know what offends a Commission official or a wealthy sponsor and avoid it. Prior study, not mastery: unfamiliar foreign customs and the hidden politics of an old hero family still trip them. Not a license: perfect manners grant no rank or invitation, and polite words do not hide bad intent from people who watch closely. It shows in correct posture, measured speech and a reflex to stand when a senior enters.
